id.description: A unique identifier for the call queue.

name.description: Unique name for the call queue.

hasCxEssentials.description: Denotes if the call queue has Customer Assist license.

enabled.description: Whether or not the call queue is enabled.

firstName.description: First name to be shown when calls are forwarded out of this call queue. Defaults to ".".

lastName.description: Last name to be shown when calls are forwarded out of this call queue. Defaults to the phone number if set, otherwise defaults to call group name.

timeZone.description: Time zone for the call queue.

phoneNumber.description: Primary phone number of the call queue.

distinctiveRingEnabled.description: Distinctive Ringing selected for the alternate numbers in the call queue overrides the normal ringing patterns set for Alternate Number.

alternateNumbers.description: Allows up to 10 numbers, each with an optional distinctive ring setting override.

alternateNumberSettings.description: The alternate numbers feature allows you to assign multiple phone numbers or extensions to a call queue. Each number will reach the same greeting and each menu will function identically to the main number. The alternate numbers option enables you to have up to ten (10) phone numbers ring into the call queue.

callPolicies.description: Policy controlling how calls are routed to agents.

allowCallWaitingForAgentsEnabled.description: Flag to indicate whether call waiting is enabled for agents.

agents.description: People, including workspaces, that are eligible to receive calls.

directLineCallerIdName.description: Settings for the direct line caller ID name to be shown for this call queue.

dialByName.description: The name to be used for dial by name functions.
